integrity: All finite claims have two independent exhaustive enumerators provided as source; the all-alphabet bound is a direct mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: General bound is not claimed sharp at every alphabet size; the exact optimizer census is restricted to ternary length-four comma-free codes of minimum Hamming distance three. Older unindexed tables may contain an equivalent enumeration. No independent external validation.
title: A projection obstruction and complete ternary census for four-symbol comma-free substitution-correcting codes
